lineage.description: The flood hazard index was elaborated by CENAPRED's Hydrometeorological Risks Subdirectorate using direct observational and anecdotal data. The resulting index aggregates flood danger information at the municipal level and is delivered as a GeoJSON vector dataset covering all Mexican municipalities.

sources.description: CENAPRED's Subdirección de Riesgos Hidrometeorológicos produced the municipal-level flood hazard index using direct observational and anecdotal data. This index characterizes flood danger at the municipal administrative unit level across Mexico.
